subject: MAGA's end-around the Constitution
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
This is what it comes down to: The sitting President of the United States is trying to exert direct control over the U.S. Postal Service to get around the Constitution, which says that states have control of elections. Courts are stopping him from directly suppressing mail-in ballots, so he's trying an end run around them using USPS.
Trump and the MAGA movement want to pick and choose whose vote counts. RUSH $35 or whatever you can right now to fight back against this abuse of the USPS and our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061026_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
NYT: Trump Signs Order Seeking Federal Control of Mail Voting as He Promotes False Claims [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061026_3&amount=25]
Straight from the New York Times , Team:
" President Trump on [March 31] stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.
Our elections are sound and mail-in voting is secure, no matter what Trump says. Step up to defend our fundamental right to vote and the use of mail-in ballots with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061026_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=061026_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=061026_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=061026_3&amount=50]

We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
But that doesn't stop Trump because he's absolutely terrified of what might happen in the next election.
Arizona’s Secretary of State (the official who runs elections), Adrian Fontes, reacted like this: “ The Constitution doesn’t allow the executive to take over elections administration, that’s a job for the state legislatures or Congress, and so I don’t think this is going to pass any sort of judicial muster. So this is a big, giant waste of time, and it’s an attention grab from the Trump administration. ”
He added: “ The greatest threat to American elections is Donald Trump lying about them. ” That''s because Donald Trump’s continued claims about large-scale “cheating” in elections are outright lies.
Protecting vote-by-mail for the upcoming midterms is crucial to make every voice heard in our elections. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can to fight lies about mail-in voting and help make every vote count? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=061026_3&amount=35]

name: Newt Gingrich
subject: Somebody has to say what nobody wants to hear
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
|
Peter, it's Newt Gingrich.

I am going to be straight with you, because that is the only way I know how to operate.

Trump Signs $70B ICE Bill

President Trump signed the [Secure America Act](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0LuOhSAYBOCngU7zw-GAFhTb2J1ttzTc1D_hFsH19Te-wjaTKSZfMT-f9WMwYt6_TQoaW1t98WtzJnsTazT7FXyNpudw3pjbyoHLAeTAYK1naTW4vnLq9ZuzaZto0ExNjL3kDBM9tLRezZILIWE2EKw3ahIABrYwT8wKivoBQTIGwN6gRgZvKfwGYlMva2dLBFzVmx5GzA19aK6UWkvEjq6N5dxp1EfvtZHXF-EL4ct936PL1o2uJMKXxyd8gScYEL7080p1QBcGBYPFGLHkAVPC_TT96duVPeZ9PHqK9NS-3s-oSUUE7MlgfGTa_33Wr-Z_AQAA__8rxnpx) on Wednesday, delivering $70 billion in funding for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) through the end of his term. The bill passed the House on Tuesday along strict party lines after four months of Republican infighting. Democrats demanded agency reforms and accountability measures; Republicans refused, and the bill cleared without a [single Democratic vote](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0D1yhSAUQOHVQKfD5QloQZHG7qVN6fDruzMIjGDcfsYtpDvVV5yf9_Y2mDDv3-YIGlvbfPFbcyZ7k2oy-xV8TabncN6Y28YZlwOTA7CtnqXV4PrGqdeCwxxnGjSoGeAlFzbTjxY2AnhlwKiFWSG9gIVP0Qg3KzGJSFE_IJMAjIFgagQm5OQjm6J6WbtYMrGretPDiLmhD82VUmtJ2NG1sZw7TfrTe23k9UX4Svh63_fobMvhbqMrB-Hrk4Sv_byOOuBx4H6ajiUP8coe8z5YTGlAFwhf6al9vTElbFKRie2HwfQ4tP_7zq_mfwEAAP__msd3qA). ICE gets $46 billion, CBP gets $24 billion—funding both agencies through January 2029. The signing closes the spring's defining domestic policy fight and hands Trump a clean win on his top legislative priority before the midterm cycle shifts into [high gear](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0E0OnSAUQOHV4AwDF0UdMOjE2eu0Q8OfehMEwsW-7TftErqBc5Lv1-f4WEyYr5_2iQaJjlDCQd7mYFNN9npjqMn2HNsXMx0gQHOhuRRHbYVq9P2AIZgZ5HquQzRyWaVUehPrcJtNrRAdTF6oSW3a6Q2CXrRy4bTbos8Bzd-g0FIKIWexjFLMegqnmM5FObc5Nom3BtvjiJkwRPKl1FoSdvQ0lnYNydy9V2LqB4Odwd7veGNKoy8Pg_0uT8zxSwx2Gx7MSL3ZjiUz2OdNrgqA9_Y-lRNembjDlPj55oD54ugj99XxfrfyXjen6EsOvMf2DM2E-sWUkPTCJnE9Fv89h_7fir8N_AkAAP__DnuFtg). ★★★
US Strikes Iran Again Today

President Trump announced Wednesday that U.S. forces would strike Iran ["hard again today,"](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DvOnDAQAODTmM5obN6FizR0mzYlGj9gRzFgecz6-tEqN_gv8BXfn9f2Qop0Hb_xDIaYN3_7jR1eHmOKeDzBp4jlCrnSxZsGPUoYpYIt5ZtTcGXTjTeDVvM-N8GoaVaqGxeYm7cB37lhH3CZnJ0d9nuHi907UJO1c_DQkPmCMCoFoAaYWgXD2Psd-n3qrF2s6OFJHkto6WLygd19p3RHKuS4vfPRRPMuJbHofgm9Cr3WWltn-QqVW3efQq-RPkH-V1jolTJesmKWJT9nkg9LLpn-BpaY0L2D0GuTjU-VYiQeJ9HDcSLFr9aUHx99jP4XAAD__1G0erU) hours after Tehran launched retaliatory missile attacks on U.S. allies Bahrain and Kuwait. The escalation comes as Trump simultaneously claims a peace deal is "days away"—a posture that has defined the conflict since U.S. and Israeli forces launched joint strikes on Iran in February. Trump says maximum pressure is the strategy; [critics say he is negotiating and bombing at the same time](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DGOhSAYBODTQKf5QQQsKLaxe9tuaVDQ9ycIBPCZvf3GK2wz1eSbZH5ey8tiwHh829MbrHVxyS11s9HZkIM9Lu9ysC36cmOsCwcuO5AdgyWXVLPf2sKpMyNnetfUG6Y0Y4OcQNO3mZgcdy3UCoP3wMU48smrXYBlu56UpmgeECRjAGwE1TMYpXA7iF0N6zqtRMCVnW2-x1jR-bqllHMK2HCrfSoHDebdWq5k-CJ8Jny-77uPvw1PX_stnYTPAT-e8PlZInyGJxg8zVSCI3zGYmN329K1cp25uyotxuUbQ8AqFRFwnBbDg9H274s-hv8FAAD__waadhA). The U.S. also confirmed it disabled an Iranian tanker in the Gulf of Oman on Wednesday, with three crewmembers reported missing. Trump declared the U.S. ["controls the Strait of Hormuz, not Iran."](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L2ynDAMhuGrMZ0Z28vyU1CkoTtpUzLC0rJKjO2xzHL7GZI7OK2K99F8v77WL-DAcf8JB80ssmLCVTxEhJAD7CdhDlAjlYujrM64XpteW7PmkiSTr6trcH46O77GhmY7jNY--smMzXumoUOYhqkbup7ME8yIjiYi_8DRb5treL6DprfWGPs0Q2vNs-_wZbrX8Ni2aVOdOTNCpZajMJL4lHJOgSt7aVPZmzC_a82iHj-UW5Rbrutq65v2EwoyxNan476mElC5JfCHlFtuVbnl9xmVW6xRbuECUV9Q9H9O9MEiHEhLLfyHRNdyHlmfogtVCAyVU9QHIwbSBFK1Lyws_xq30pQZ88UhsPSD6sx-AIf7m6Z-e-fP7P4GAAD__x7Xklg) ★★★
SCOTUS Mail-In Ballot Ruling Due

The Supreme Court is in the final stretch of its term with a consequential ruling pending on whether states can count [mail-in ballots that arrive after Election Day](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0LHupiAQBPCnwU6zoIIWFNfYfddeaRBW3WQVAnjf61_MvcG_nl9mkvnzWT-OmO7jt7vQUilriGEt3t3BcWJ3PBgSu3pj_tJdVgVKt6BbCWvKsST0dVVNsKOS0z41aKWZpOz1DFNz2nnGfRynqUcjdzDGea-V7ncT_DgM_dSQfQtBSwkgRzCdhFEPYYdhN_22zZsY4EnBVezoLhSw-BhTikyVfOliPhq2Z62piP6XUItQSz3xJObOx0uoJePxsKsUb6EWH59c283VyliEWsZZGtC6LU_KeGH7P78ccUt3uznmWF_XZBvSl5ipaCMGOF7yDjT1x5f9tepfAAAA__8YMH34). The case centers on a Mississippi law allowing late-arriving ballots. If the conservative majority strikes it down, grace periods in California and several other states would be invalidated—directly reshaping how [November's midterms are counted](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0L3SpCAQheGrwUyraX8nINjEbDbd0EJona4CoWjc2cvf8ha-5AQneIL3z3t7Ww58nb9tJMMim09-E2cvb0MO9rzJ52DrReXLl2wIOLUwtRq2XJJkcnXDxpsR9XIsDRk9L1r30wuW5mP6Gfpln3ZH-zHS8ELCBWke92G2dCzYsHlAmLQG0CPMnYZxGvwBwzH3-_7a1QB39rZSx5ewJ3Ep5ZwCV3bSpXI2wXxqzaL6XwpXhav9x0k6l6LC9cEVrvCMBoWr3LlQpNalu9S2ljvmlgK5yumSNrKvVKK0HCOfxT5vU4zPXw6BZZrVAGe0HB6-qT_O9dfg_wAAAP__J1585A) in states where late mail is common. NPR reports the ruling could also affect Alaska, where extreme weather routinely delays ballot delivery. A decision is expected within weeks, before state election officials begin [finalizing midterm procedures](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0DEO3CAQheHT4G4swAa8BUUad5s2pTUL410kFpAHx8ntI18hzWue9BX_r-f2xJRTef_EL_nEvMUaNw5YIuaW8X1SbBl7oeNKhTcttQVpQcmtHZUbhb7pIXqj1bIvA3nlFqUm-5DL8PHGTg-ng1Oo3WRsjFa56MKitJmdcWFI_galVUpKZaQblTR2jrucdze9Xo-XmOXZInYaU-EUiUOtrdWcego81uM9ZP_pvbGYfgi9Cr1e1zWWdtyf0OvNC73Ke5QUei1_gBWYRVq9GKFXDrWfDJFC4lQL1AJfTBlSgRfmXDtDqGeOgPtOoQN37MRwfegguAj7hw4IWCDgyQSRMv7l4fCxXSnnxNaJWb5vcgz1O_T_bvzb638BAAD__yFQjNU).

name: Mike Rogers
subject: I saw Osama bin Laden's cold, dead body.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rogers for Senate
body:
Here’s what the moment meant then, and what it means now.

| |
---

---
Friend, I've worn many hats in my life. I'm a proud husband and a father. I was the third of four generations in my family to serve in the United States military. I was an FBI agent in the early 90s -- back when we locked up bad guys like human traffickers and drug dealers. And in Congress, I served as the **Chairman of The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.**
---
[ | It was in this capacity that I experienced one of the biggest defining moments of my life. On May 2, 2011 Osama bin Laden — the worst enemy America has ever known — was killed dead in his home by some of America's bravest heroes. Seeing the photo of Osama bin Laden's cold, dead body riddled with bullets was one of the most surreal moments I've ever experienced. In a weird way, it sent both a chill up my spine, while also bringing an indescribable level of calmness.
--- ](https://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=293de5a6223e4436ab53fb8020578890&_m=3654996666254668874da3398badc7f0&_e=Y6tGrzJwFIvFzFhNbW9XqahpL8SU4LiX5l5KQMUtAbY-cIeUXemRis2ayHTe2mV2BV6zE9dNlIqxqNJLPe-YsOVdCrqT-4jY1u7UODfv9Ic8Meo6fNALgnwwvHJdQEm302d4JNFz6n3pDyGbZHZaCDqt9w9C-LjuhUl1p0kk0Qcgo7RKc6TnHluUEl4F9sEp0e-7QLyERXJVBUqaNTdp6C6vICugIFGnniMZAS2_3Cd_L0nAuDElCaHby_wzekOOAZtXG3-jScX7VFLh-frHNB9imiLmNQg-svVvcYIgRPkFMWaiNM58icyYiSbOGWmwJOE6YKJWMEvEYjOjiTdolnKRdJZi7fyiSQjn746qg-rc3NkriY0uKw0SDp6THnun6HfqGdFuvixIhZuD67gDrLwZsftKpsgME6NygG5V35U5G3buA-ygnccGHOU04Pl5XxRN8mUMW80z0pN4FAOdJmH-SdUkbe4N0gbswIJIWErYrC0bmbI9b2q-IMAoHVd7T_JQHdsS7U0U5k5z8Ud5ZXIO-dwTFrjWBg5q6VwJEOt2-HUD9eTIxLEpygXm2z0oeap8Miht8ujyZCZUB0hkEuhcBxbAewfN1zDhFOl9f94UWPUAnlMYM5Zxz_4UeiHvsArejepanCRslfRHZw_YRsHgIYpOL-zBffRdi6WcQvq3sgxHjWIP8edoJCrUVyb9eG3mfyH2D9zwaVd8rUm9H5S2I-HoguGartrzX6jfsio%3D)
10 years after the attacks on September 11th, and finally, we captured and killed the man responsible for shaking our nation to its core. But that calm feeling didn't last for long.
---
[ | You see, right now America is at a crossroads. We have foreign enemies trying to see to our downfall while radical, brainwashed sympathizers right here at home cheer it on.
--- ](https://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=293de5a6223e4436ab53fb8020578890&_m=3654996666254668874da3398badc7f0&_e=Y6tGrzJwFIvFzFhNbW9XqahpL8SU4LiX5l5KQMUtAbY-cIeUXemRis2ayHTe2mV2BV6zE9dNlIqxqNJLPe-YsOVdCrqT-4jY1u7UODfv9Ic8Meo6fNALgnwwvHJdQEm302d4JNFz6n3pDyGbZHZaCDqt9w9C-LjuhUl1p0kk0Qcgo7RKc6TnHluUEl4F9sEp0e-7QLyERXJVBUqaNTdp6C6vICugIFGnniMZAS2_3Cd_L0nAuDElCaHby_wzekOOAZtXG3-jScX7VFLh-frHNL9-3Z65VRcqx_BxBGt5Fu_rKkrYK2o6VfBpbcgxmKRDPGut2T7HTrf6bRmxS2q71m0EQMjJ5TZsMxPaPsrUls5IzaAuIKKLK012emAzOom4YvalS8GSguauEUPOZiHTHIlNd24oJoEQj_k-LFU5pwETAc5fwchfqouH2Z-m91reGw7MThJK_LK4isZCHeh_4UucalsVhJkBRKcSTpO0gZD9yH5RowSR_HWOrGrEI6TODEIHFILNV9waiOVl4WCvUErVnMGxLGf-vHt2brAKyjcfauKowExRs8CFU9sUJv8aBVP60uz4T3iuCIpnk7-j5GyaPpUioG6ZmbezPeqOiiiIIsFUPoUg7KPo8j8yzJN-vmIa0uYayGr4VTT0eyICI6RqduxfEoq3mBWMVxUAQLnnZhHcKmWNp5DREZXyxWq6hv8wXsakI6FDtiTNjqSGyrPyUFG3nxlT7sD58iYxcoc%3D)
I say enough is enough.
---
[ | I've worn this nation's uniform as an officer in the United States Army. My father served in the Air Force. My brother served in the Army and fought in Iraq. My wife deployed to Iraq while working for the Department of Defense and **survived an IED explosion.** And most recently, our son served in the Navy. My family has given our blood, sweat, and tears to this country. And I'm damn proud that we did.
--- ](https://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=293de5a6223e4436ab53fb8020578890&_m=3654996666254668874da3398badc7f0&_e=Y6tGrzJwFIvFzFhNbW9XqahpL8SU4LiX5l5KQMUtAbY-cIeUXemRis2ayHTe2mV2BV6zE9dNlIqxqNJLPe-YsOVdCrqT-4jY1u7UODfv9Ic8Meo6fNALgnwwvHJdQEm302d4JNFz6n3pDyGbZHZaCDqt9w9C-LjuhUl1p0kk0Qcgo7RKc6TnHluUEl4F9sEp0e-7QLyERXJVBUqaNTdp6C6vICugIFGnniMZAS2_3Cd_L0nAuDElCaHby_wzekOOAZtXG3-jScX7VFLh-frHNPVQTKZWEFx9WuCinHtuR2NMyW9KZqW1l-kLkz1D0bKb0MkMpfB_Lz3eVQ4askOTlaTqXjI_5NFqO2CC1VwkYVlfhkEYqEupElz3mkkM_h1yBtwR3quiyB4Ge9r7x3Ij7hCu-KxsPCSOA5lR0-mwtYTnj4MZbN7-kwZh2uUmDG_YRVDoBoLuOIp7YheNaVZf4R8Zgdr6U9QAUc8jgB-u1JuyZHm33MUic9LOOu9IadmJWjCu59obh_kiPoxrgPCUFAnl_eWpdYr1mSx5OqAmnNzQhnQZXxxKlmskYLIz35FTyIxWrU07Z2RwApiad14oakHyGXzj_GbzPw7edHRINZc5u-dRJEuAg8Dde0GgV72wMRareKCrw9nDSMQZePk1tOZtnNFxyTG0RmiBBs3JIAaJbfrYn3tbEbYTaRK_7M1871z0TRoqfZv_h7_ZhS9lkNw2JulBygrWsXvE7dGr10Q%3D)
But our fight is not over yet. President Trump has set out on a mission to undo all of the disasters of the last four years -- but not even he can do that alone. I'm running for the United States Senate to add one more hat to my shelf. This time, it's bright red and has four words written across the front:

clean_body: Here’s what the moment meant then, and what it means now. | | Friend, I've worn many hats in my life. I'm a proud husband and a father. I was the third of four generations in my family to serve in the United States military. I was an FBI agent in the early 90s -- back when we locked up bad guys like human traffickers and drug dealers. And in Congress, I served as the Chairman of The House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence. 10 years after the attacks on September 11th, and finally, we captured and killed the man responsible for shaking our nation to its core. But that calm feeling didn't last for long. I say enough is enough. But our fight is not over yet. President Trump has set out on a mission to undo all of the disasters of the last four years -- but not even he can do that alone. I'm running for the United States Senate to add one more hat to my shelf. name: Sherrod Brown
subject: NEW POLLING IN OHIO: 53-45
disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
A Fox News poll shows me ahead in Ohio’s Senate race.
#
Peter –
The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S)
This is a big deal. It’s the first public poll of the general election – and the data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November.
**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.[Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and State Democrats Committee so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S)**
**[DONATE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S)**
What we’re building together is truly remarkable, and I see it at every stop I make across the state. Folks are fed up with rising costs, rampant corruption, and a rigged system that makes it impossible to get ahead no matter how hard you work. So they’re showing up to make a change and proving that we have the support to flip this seat, even in a state Trump won by 11 points last time.
Seriously, we’re 8 points ahead of our opponent in this latest poll. _That’s the good news._
Here’s the tough part: Outside Republican groups and corporations see these polls, too. **They’ve already publicly announced I’m one of their top targets and are spending $83 million against me, so another poll like this will give them all the more reason to dump a fortune into Ohio to take me down.**
I don’t know what’s coming next, but I know the _only_ way we can keep this going in our favor is by fighting hard each and every day until the election. Ohio broke the record for the most expensive Senate race in history last time, so we need a lot of support if we’re going to pull this off.
**Your $5 might not seem like a lot on its own, but it all adds up when thousands of folks chip in whatever they can, whenever they can – even if it’s just $5 at a time.[If you’re with me, I’m earnestly asking if you can split a donation between my campaign and State Democrats Committee before midnight. Everything counts and means a ton to me personally.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S)**

[Contribute $5](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=5&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Contribute $15](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=6&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105169?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/105168?refcode=em20260610-10553&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=10553%2E614464%2Eu8iw3S)

My name is Tom Cotton. I grew up on my family's cattle farm in Dardanelle, Arkansas. My folks have farmed this land for seven generations. My dad worked for the state. My mom was a school teacher and later a principal.
[](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/rSEX_M6XjCTB29MbQdMWRtQ4AFGVdfCwvadDS80-GpRw3KxgZq3MeOAh61DWkx6UlCbjTgB_iqUTTLwZGpx-HpZHTDiNX4WoUQFdf41ZgiQxjiq1jTwJq7iLkQcnz_mK1UVp2tUvUEqx-2SwTnMYDCo4auHfUM3aPsdJi6cCLig9lglS06uJFYFMX62yfqNlPLgcAKTokmg30kFqh8gWZgnRMufmlQMB_SHB2VTZiHH6jcgms0DOyz2t0nFjxxlGEL4J5E9j9f5ZHJC5WSOlh4t50LDuK31ZzG7VXop1STD7YjA_ePRXvXmgFBAcF9X2LsPg6CQuCFIuj__0B68WK6dF05UNzahFizJm8v4fpA1FIdCZLfRxnUPQy3m-4vdE0IpzwD-9Pat1FVZjh29xFs8MDGr5-FGblh5nx_I-0cnlcM2ojArYRkZtYfK1yYXw8wxWDoF8u_swhDREUa7-4n9XmtVNP4YLtPcOZHTDiy6wwkNg8n90pgR7Zl5ypjqHb-lS-A8Qss14FIb4zHh7M0rm3mHMPMO75LIsR7NMt4hPJnnPTWk-4TE5RT7dp0HiipR42IEqtUrqYWo1uNWxeqWAeB9mS63PRSJmhDpAw5cAMZUx_dNig-xH_58WUqFcg-Maly7mjxvZBteHIS3uUyERStU66igTF4nVVTTnovoo_yS7W1PXB7zJ1s6ecMrbyhvX1vXx1jP5jb_12ggwqs_qzHLJ8QA-A00ZLcsiPtKTii--3CNUyNyVi36Z4g3Z8BuE71pt7jTtllbkNMtf3wAurIP8Xlb8Rw-ZNCcHfLelEHVW6J-uKNxSrhMo1jovoJNm7Z6T4zDl_ahf4fHlTJGRRrdS2BC9E9siVxWWeriL_9dfzBwm6tZ2vVJIoBjjk6Yw9EjRQEKBt7p-gLcuse5-1kdbRyMpCa49O_-QVuFJrvdpqSBNxk4/1cUYCxzocdLYSjbADPFC-cM-uSFocmsI/21)

_Then came September 11._

name: NHGOP Headquarters
subject: New Hampshire Republican Party Hires New Communications Director
body:
New Hampshire Republican Party Hires New Communications Director

| | | | | | |

---
| |

| | | | | | | **New Hampshire Republican State Committee Hires Karina Nicholas as Communications Director**
A few weeks ago, I announced that I was looking for funding to hire a Communications Director. Thanks in part to your donations, below is the press release announcing Karina’s hiring. She is going to be fabulous, and you will see a lot more messaging coming from the state party soon.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE June 9th, 2026****CONTACT karina@nhrsc.com**
CONCORD, N.H. — The New Hampshire Republican State Committee (NHRSC) announced the hiring of Karina Nicholas as its new Communications Director.
A native of Stratham, Nicholas recently graduated from Hope College with a Bachelor of Arts in English. She joins the NHRSC after serving as an intern in Governor Chris Sununu's office in 2024 and as an assistant in the New Hampshire Senate Clerk's Office in 2025. Nicholas also serves as Communications Director for the New Hampshire Federation of Republican Women.
"We are excited to welcome Karina to the team," said Scott Maltzie, Chairman of the New Hampshire Republican State Committee. "Her passion for Republican principles, strong communications skills, and commitment to advancing our message make her a tremendous asset as we prepare for the upcoming election cycle."

## Report: El Paso Detention Facility Wasted Millions
The rushed opening of Camp East Montana, the nation's largest immigration detention facility, led to up to [$11.5 million in wasted taxpayer money](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUD2TpCAQ_TWYMdUwKBoQXEK2l15o9UC7UotiQe86_vsr7y9c8l7y6n39-Zg_MOW0f_7GjRy_lzLvdLZMzFTns9Qcw_fxlcJXK8vCK7WANdGsQQ8SBqnUHDHlazZddC-Ik-rIKTsqZXs7qW51xsA0GLtY9eqfL0VEPQEoE2KwMIxTl9xtBoNSSsETpkcPOoIhO0YkO40oDFBMXOqDV2J6Y1vyVX6oPkLZuuxW5qOJ5y-hvdD-PM_Hd0MuEa9bILRvXOoltL-X3YScyi60v3OF9nCDAqE9ZXlgKzLgdkjCxnIrO-OOMgWSC4aUE1-y0lEqyyXtsclIyGuTJzYmof0EZhz1aACs0L6rLh5nyjm1wQoDnxum_K82_9_ZP07_DQAA__9WtJIO) and unsafe conditions for detainees and staff, according to a Government Accountability Office report released Tuesday. The Army paid for guards, medical services, transportation, and meals at the Fort Bliss facility in El Paso for two weeks in August 2025 before [any detainees arrived](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2yozAMhZ_GdMrYDjGhoNiG7m67JSNsETQxmLGVv7ffcV7hNmr06Yy-Of9-ph_kyPvtL240yHtJ006vEkmE8vRKOQb_OO7s7yUti6xUPGamyWrrQDswZgrI8TO1TRhmHXrT0GC6qzHdpetNsw5z79CZ2bXLfLV2bs-OdOs6mj3OF93qhocapp0xxuiz7k8XbYNuqbsGpK6_omo1BZaUT7KS0BvLEj_pSfnk09bEYRU5ijr_UXZUdiwHecmPLSaPsbpUStlR3nWZHrLCNwMowoElKTtWStmxvqHsqL-jV3aMmG9UBNgTBBLahdMOC3qOLB94YREKsHGMnPYCuAc4HlJR5J2oAApkLneATEfKAgvvoTR5CMerHhXXqVbfNuT4VZHfFfAc7P8AAAD__570nU8), and the $1.3 billion contract required payments for 5,000 detainees even when the camp held about 1,600. The report found the camp opened without perimeter security cameras or a required inspection, and a contractor [lost a loaded firearm](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuS5CAMhk-DM1zA-BkQbEI2m27owpZsU43BBZqm-_Zb9BUmUfLr-_T49718W-ddOP7aCzW99rgELNkjEaalxORh-7kfbnvkuO90Yt5scrgooQYuBi7lAtb599I1oFcBs2xQy3GScuzHWTanBjWNs9pgVWISvbD92kuJIGbAbtjXtXG6ysQgpZTiS8xtLxSIDscJLI7zZFknEBzF1NKJhC-bd_-OT0ztFq_G65PozuzrD1OGKVNKaR_ZUg2ZMvUapswHY8rUUUwZ8SkzU-aoonBhIF4sbSfEg2f7zhyQMJCLgW8YCBMvNhMC_7k5RS5lzy_nfc1X3GPCClgXEDO3KbknAlOmSRruUvvyMLJOHJd1_rM2_e7ZT63-BwAA___o3ZUW) that was never recovered. Three detainees have died at the facility, including one death ruled a homicide in which evidence was missing or destroyed, and a suicide that followed lapses in monitoring protocols. ICE has since replaced the original contractor, Acquisition Logistics LLC, and said the facility "is upgrading" rather than closing.
## Abbott Eyes Data Center Crackdown
Gov. Greg Abbott directed Texas utility regulators this week to shield residential electricity customers from costs tied to the state's [booming data center industry](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ_GdCDvBjAuXFxD9197JTL2Eqw4GNmbOHn7U_IKfzfSSDOfvn8_y48NMRzXv_ZOhl9bWg6qJRIz5aWmHL17nLfgbiVtG-9UnM2BFpQ4tnJsARZvQ3wvfePNKr2GhgyoCUANSkOzm5WcBL0pmPoJgMAr1N46K6cVvcaxCeYzJkcAAHmRuhsketmTmrwlpScrekk-cMod78T0smWL7_Sk3Ll0b6LZmc8iLn8EzgLnWmvn9pyOTytwXh8lHFSKwJnJ7UeK6foWONvMwUX6pHVNzK23bFtHB1NuXbbu5lM92u9fi4haD8OlO_ezycafNcQYyqhEL693G-IXhX8n8GnwfwAAAP__kCOGWQ), while also recommending broad new regulations for lawmakers to pass in 2027. In a letter to the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUC) and ERCOT, Abbott ordered that data centers [fully fund the electric infrastructure](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0b-O4yAQx_Gnwd1EA8bBFC6ucbfXXmnxZ0jQkmDBbLz79ifnFbae0Uf66vfvY_twueTn7a970MLfqW5POnohZmrbUVuJ4Wv_zOGz15T4Tj24lmlTqK6AV5Byiy6Xn00PcfEYrRxokWaW0kzGyuG-GEIZNWrjvXWjTjPFyRuLftTGU0hDXk4Mr1JKiSPay4QqoiYzR0fGzk5opJi5tgvfienb9VR-6ovaJdTHUJY7897F-EeoVaj1OI7LkZw7j0KtrnEOhYRazy6h1lKDK0Ktb0io9VZf4LyvzFBbpNZh_wpALVQGrrC3yhQY3u_QqOdIT-6QWn1AdOwg0JOpQaidT0_NBhKi9hQRRjta0OM0g7UxwhRwmqdpVGnWQ1vifuRScr8aofH2cLm8i_h3O7wW9T8AAP__V2Scjg) needed to serve their operations. The agencies must submit a joint memo on additional safeguards by July 17, and the PUC must act to reduce residential transmission costs by July 31. Abbott's legislative wish list includes requiring new facilities to add power generation to the grid, mandating water-efficient closed-loop cooling systems, requiring annual reporting on electricity and water use, and [repealing the data center sales tax exemption](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMQL8mdBk5GRaGIsU1dHvtlchgD0QTEpR4Nuzfn9hf2MZ6kp-eLP_7nD7RBx_Xv7izk_OZpsi1BBbhPNWUAy3v4-WXV0nPp2xcFsyeJwu209BpYyZCH76ntiE3Aw2mYWf6hzH9Rz-YZnPzD3AH9wHIzETtnWjokWYwA8_QeHfFoDPGGLjDcPsAS9By_yDkfnigaoHJS8o32Vj4xPIM3-mL821JexPcJnIUdf-j7KjsWGu9vaqc11LZ8WorO8I1DCg74jwnEZ15SfvOkYoulfnwcdWEgnrhKJx15vUdUHyK2sclvOkSOPjdR5SLCwYuWvDUfPJ-XKayY5MdHdWH4EvXqxbWHX34uVN-990vZ_8HAAD__wVykRc)—projected to cost Texas $3.2 billion over the next two years. Texas has 335 existing data centers, and large projects seeking grid connections total 439 gigawatts, roughly five times the grid's all-time peak demand.
## The World Cup Is Here
The 2026 FIFA World Cup [kicks off today](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSgyAURb9GOx0eKmpBsU26bLslg7xHZEKCAySYv99hf2Hre-fcOffnqq7aefe8fesHyXzaoJ5UkqecKaoSokfzOu7O3FOwNu-UjI6OFGdcdEx0AAq18x81tig3hiu0JGFeAOZpXqHd5cQmMWyDMbQgTlrAug0bEWzDZHHhonWywpgAAGADW_uJcWQjzQtqmtdFNyMjdDnEPu-U6dTJ-k94U-xNeLRe7jkfqRm-Gn5p-KWU0ttwjlWjFhp-SUeIOdWs-nTmdXTJ7IQvT13dbqPEozjvXRJzM7LbQzv_B8__u-Qt-W8AAAD__yindl0), launching a 48-team, 104-match tournament across 16 host cities in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The opener pits [Mexico against South Africa](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u6yAQhuHV4A6LIcQ_BcVt3OW2p7QwDDEKDhaMQ7L7I2cLpx-N3uf7uc03E2J43v-bDTW9fZqfWEtEIsxzTTk6e-yPYB8leU8rFmtywFkK2XHRcYDZmRA_s2qcXoQboUEN_QDQX_sRmlXDsgDC4pUavDXyopw0YOEqUIDyg2yCPp-JDgBAXMTYXoV0QmE_OIP9OBimBLpAKbe0IuHbFB8_6YW5tWlrol6J9sIu_5icmJxqre1zsWVPmcp5weRUkrWYmZxOG5PTt_6L4_bYebEruiMiP508ec8pbFh4IePCsRXuDGHh95yOvfA1VU6JV0N25TG8kC_Z2AdSk7Xba4gxlK5nStw3E-K3kf627EvL3wAAAP__tHWQuw) at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City at 2 p.m. Central, with the U.S. men's national team debuting Friday against Paraguay in Los Angeles. The tournament runs through the July 19 final at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. Neither Texas venue hosts a game today, but the party is already on. Fair Park in Dallas opens its free FIFA Fan Festival this afternoon—big screens, food, and family viewing areas on all 34 match days through July 19. Texas hosts more matches than any other state. AT&T Stadium in Arlington will stage nine matches, the most of any venue, starting on Sunday, when the [Netherlands faces Japan](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSgyAUgOHTYKfzICpSUGxjl223dJD3DEwwZAAluf1O9grb__MV_891uRof_OP2bXbS5bXF5UE1ByqF0lJjCmiP593be47bVhxla5KnRYAYWxhbzhc0PryXvkG9AirekOZy4lwOUvHGaYvTOkhQSlpUF2VpU5Z6XOUAsIrRNF5_MBg55xwuoLoBBEJPckJDUk2G9UDoS0xdcVToZfIW3vGk1Nm4N0G7Up6ZXb6YmJmYa60dmhBM3qoV46dhYo5Hak96HJSZmHdTrGuzdYRHICbmJml8Vh-Cz6NkPdx248OfXv735NTiNwAA__-sX3bP) at 3 p.m. NRG Stadium in Houston hosts [seven matches](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uqzAQhJ8GOiPb_BgKF7ehy21PiRx7HawYFnk3IXn7o-QVTjfFaDTf93NZLi7ltN_-uw0svyIuO5yUgRnKcmLJwT-Oe_J3whh5BfKuJFi01IOQg1BqCS7l99LVwV5lmFQNVplRKdObSdWrjVcfnY5jG_pR977TprvKdlSdGWOvPNTJfsbkoJRSspVT00sdZAdmDA7MNLqqkxASY2l4BYaXo5jf-ITSeNzqbFfmg6r2X6XnSs_neTYRX3RgYfo0Kj0TY0lAn4TeQ6n0_AX48gn_OMTm2K9AYsUHMe6C2BUWnDYgERwDiYzeccKd6mLDcaacEw2m6uRtcyl_r_DfBD6t_g0AAP__MvqH7g), opening Sunday with Germany vs. Curaçao at noon, plus a round-of-32 match and a July 4 knockout game.
| Flying together with our sponsor [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAQhuGrwV0sBjvGLiiOdOQu226JCDPYoxATAfm7-5WjvYMtnylGr77vkz05jrwtX-5Kpr5Cshs9S6RaKdtnyhH9_XZhfykphLpS8S4zWSXVcJDDAcCi4_i2fYPmLHGChgzoEUAf9QTNarQC3SECjN6Bl2M_nY-d9z2586gQXcNmfyYHAADZyak9SoWyJz2iIz2NTvSSkGvKbV2p0suVEN_pQbn16dpEs9Z6K6L7J9Qs1IzkYsubT8vGLSehZheC9aKbUwiULaPo_g9CDfv5A-j07nuOvxZqKOmePe3ItHDaXNwDm2zw9uQYuQxa9HK5Oo6fivq37R5G_QQAAP__P4OBOg) **That scam call wasn 't random.** Scammers don't just guess your number. [They buy personal information from data brokers](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAQhuGrwV0sBjvGLiiOdOQu226JCDPYoxATAfm7-5WjvYMtnylGr77vkz05jrwtX-5Kpr5Cshs9S6RaKdtnyhH9_XZhfykphLpS8S4zWSXVcJDDAcCi4_i2fYPmLHGChgzoEUAf9QTNarQC3SECjN6Bl2M_nY-d9z2586gQXcNmfyYHAADZyak9SoWyJz2iIz2NTvSSkGvKbV2p0suVEN_pQbn16dpEs9Z6K6L7J9Qs1IzkYsubT8vGLSehZheC9aKbUwiULaPo_g9CDfv5A-j07nuOvxZqKOmePe3ItHDaXNwDm2zw9uQYuQxa9HK5Oo6fivq37R5G_QQAAP__P4OBOg), companies selling your phone number, home address, relatives' info, and more online. That's how a random scam call can turn into phishing, impersonation, identity theft, or someone knowing more about you than they should.
